inputs.name: revenue
inputs.note: SEC filings public at the cutoff.

inputs.name: cash
inputs.note: Last balance sheet public at the cutoff.

inputs.name: debt
inputs.note: Last balance sheet public at the cutoff.

inputs.name: rd_ratio
inputs.note: Last four quarters; 0 if not reported.

inputs.name: ebitda_margin_path
inputs.note: Signed research pairs at 4 and 8 quarters; interpolated, then held flat.

inputs.name: growth_path
inputs.note: Transparent rule; the model is not signed for growth.

inputs.name: ppe
inputs.note: D&A of the last year over an assumed 12.5% rate.

inputs.name: trade_nwc
inputs.note: 12% of annualized revenue: the warehouse holds no working capital.

inputs.name: goodwill
inputs.note: Zero: not in the warehouse. It moves book equity and gains, not cash.

inputs.name: interest_rate
inputs.note: Fed funds + 2 points, 30% floating: interest is not in the warehouse.

inputs.name: liquidity
inputs.note: Minimum cash 2% and revolver 5% of revenue; covenants 3.5x and 3x.

inputs.name: deal_accounting
inputs.note: The target moves with the company; 15% PP&E, 25% intangibles over 10 years.

inputs.name: capital_cost
inputs.note: ERP 5%, beta 1, debt weight 15%, growth 2.5%; 10-year Treasury observed.
